_README: Sections and topics are filled in; `quote` is EMPTY until a human pastes the OFFICIAL text (Official Gazette, LawPhil, or DMW). The backend sends ONLY verified=true entries. RA 8042 (1995) was heavily AMENDED by RA 10022 (2010) and RA 11641 (2021, created the DMW): quote the CURRENT amended text, not the 1995 original, and say 'as amended' in the label. Keep each quote (or its excerpt) under ~400 characters so two fit in Lumen's 2000-character message; for longer sections add an `excerpt` array of exact pieces of the quote.
source: Republic Act No. 8042 (Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act of 1995), as amended by RA 10022
covers: Overseas Filipino Workers (land-based and sea-based) and their recruitment agencies. Not kasambahay working in the Philippines, not local employees.

references.label: RA 8042 as amended, Sec. 6 (Definition of Illegal Recruitment)
references._note: Covers charging excessive fees and substituting or altering the approved contract to the worker's prejudice. Quote ONLY the sub-items you need (e.g. the contract-substitution item), not the whole list.

references.label: RA 8042 as amended, Sec. 10 (Money Claims)
references._note: Joint and solidary liability of the PH agency and foreign employer; what the worker may claim if dismissed without just cause. This section was amended by RA 10022 and parts were ruled on by the Supreme Court: use the current text and keep the quote short.

references.label: RA 8042 as amended, Sec. 15 (Repatriation of Workers)
references._note: Who pays to bring the worker home. Check the amended text for when the worker pays (e.g. termination due to the worker's fault).

references.label: RA 8042 as amended, Sec. 7 (Penalties)
references._note: Optional. Only add if a demo question needs it; penalties are long and rarely what the worker asks.
